## Speed Analysis

This section analyses the speed variable from the cars dataset.

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-speed
#| fig-cap: "Speed Distribution"
hist(cars$speed, main = "Speed Distribution", xlab = "Speed")
```
